keyVerseDR: "Fear not therefore: better are you than many sparrows." (Mt 10:31)

level1.title: Don't Be Afraid
level1.story: Jesus said, "Do not be afraid! God knows every little bird." God even counts the hairs on your head. You are worth more than many sparrows!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, I am not afraid with You. Amen.

activity.title: God knows me
activity.intro: Use the first letters to solve the crossword.
entries: A little bird God watches over
God counts every one on your head
He knows when a sparrow falls

level2.title: Worth More Than Sparrows
level2.story: Jesus told His disciples not to be afraid of people. What He told them in the dark, they must speak in the light. "Are not two sparrows sold for a small coin?" He asked. Yet not one falls to the ground without the Father knowing. "Even all the hairs of your head are counted. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows."
level2.keyLine: Fear not: better are you than many sparrows.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: When is it hard to say you follow Jesus?
level2.prayer: Father, give me courage to speak of Jesus. Amen.

activity.title: A courage verse
activity.text: Fear not therefore: better are you than many sparrows.
